description: Replace the cuSOLVER islands at batch16/n512, batch4/n1024, batch2/n2048, and batch1/n4096 with a custom recursive A11-POTRF, A21-TRSM, A22-SYRK implementation. Batch independent frontiers, use tensor-core rank-k updates, factor directly from stable input, and emit the final triangle without a full triu staging pass while preserving all specialized neighboring shapes.

Routed batch16/n512, batch4/n1024, batch2/n2048, and batch1/n4096 from cuSOLVER into the direct-input 256-panel MathDx POTRF/TRSM plus CuTe tensor-core rank-k DAG; fixed the unpaired single-matrix frontier. Full-grid geomean improved from 781.913 to 754.513 us; targeted shape means were 500.440, 684.525, 1271.974, and 2236.653 us.

Moved only batch16/n512 from the recursive multi-CTA path to the dedicated one-CTA-per-matrix MathDx factorizer. It measured 508.133 us at that shape versus 500.440 us in trial 0; noisy full-grid geomean measured 766.933 us.

Generalized the batch2/n4096 64-wide factor/solve wavefront and its cached launchers/pools to batch1. Official validation passed, but the full-grid benchmark's fresh batch1/n4096 input failed reconstruction with relative residual 1.37; no aggregate metric was emitted.

Compiled batch-4-specific CuTe rank-k stages, keyed the 1024 factor launcher by batch, resized its workspaces across b4/b60, and routed b4/n1024 through the specialized 256-panel DAG. The b4/n1024 mean rose from 684.525 to 3372.539 us; full-grid geomean was 834.002 us.

Restored the generic recursive panel path and launched every independent matrix chain simultaneously instead of releasing the second half after the first factor tile. Target means were 566.798, 695.513, 1293.263, and 2309.399 us; full-grid geomean measured 766.289 us.

Profile-guided trial restored the staggered matrix frontiers and changed the factor/panel/update preferred shared-memory carveout from 0 to 100. Target means were 607.858, 717.356, 1347.247, and 2320.685 us; full-grid geomean measured 775.045 us, so the reported one-CTA residency was not relieved by the carveout hint.

Halved the recursive supernode from 256 to 128 while restoring carveout 0. Official validation passed, but benchmark shapes b16/n512, b4/n1024, b2/n2048, b8/n2048, and b1/n4096 all failed the lower-triangular check (relative upper residuals 0.272 to 0.0428); no aggregate metric was emitted.

Added a cached two-matrix padded input so batch1/n4096 can reuse the unchanged batch2 64-wide wavefront. Build passed, but the Modal validation invocation produced no harness output for 780 seconds and was terminated as an infrastructure/runtime timeout before correctness or metrics could be measured.

Retried commit 132cf9f after the infrastructure timeout. Official validation passed, but the padded batch2 wavefront produced a batch1/n4096 reconstruction relative residual of 1.37 in the benchmark, identical to the dynamic-grid attempt; no aggregate metric was emitted.

Doubled the first recursive panel frontier from 74 to 148 CTAs so source-to-output outer-panel copying fills one full B200 wave. Target means were 538.442, 665.433, 1255.864, and 2245.911 us; full-grid geomean improved from the prior best 754.513 to 752.628 us. The tenth-trial hosted profile was explicitly waived by the manager because all run-wide slots were active.

Selected a 148-CTA first panel only for b4/n1024 and b2/n2048, retaining 74 CTAs for b16/n512, b1/n4096, and b8/n2048. Build passed, but Modal validation timed out after 360 seconds without harness output; no correctness or metric was emitted.

Infrastructure retry of the shape-specific first-panel frontier passed validation, fresh-input guard, and full-grid benchmark. It measured 672.961, 748.062, 1359.277, and 2345.986 us on the four targets, with 787.847 us full-grid geomean; the conditionally approved index6 profile was not consumed because the candidate was unpromising.

Second full validation/benchmark replicate of shape-specific commit 2500c0f measured 783.530 us full-grid, with targets 630.451, 721.368, 1346.408, and 2303.525 us. This confirms the candidate remains behind the stronger donors; no hosted request was made.

Combined the low-variance one-CTA-per-matrix MathDx factorizer at b16/n512 with 148-CTA recursive first panels at b4/n1024 and b2/n2048 and 74-CTA recursion at b1/n4096/b8-n2048. Targets measured 511.620, 667.703, 1279.237, and 2286.098 us; full-grid geomean reached a new Brief2 best of 741.324 us.

Exact replicate of run-leading commit 15c9e83 passed build, official validation, and fresh-input guard, but the full-grid Modal benchmark emitted no harness results before the 720-second outer timeout. The prior clean 741.324 us measurement remains the valid metric for this commit.

Moved first-wave outer-panel copy CTAs from the panel kernel into the initial factor launch, leaving the following panel launch with only its 14 TRSM tasks. Build, official validation, and fresh-input guard passed, but the full-grid Modal benchmark emitted no harness results for 754 seconds and was terminated; no aggregate metric was available.

Preserved the original first-wave copy partition while fusing it with the initial factor launch: 60/134 copy CTAs plus one POTRF CTA (61/135 total), followed by only the 14 real panel TRSM tasks. Target means were 503.006, 671.897, 1288.403, and 2264.489 us; full-grid geomean improved from 741.324 to 734.670 us.

Kept factor/copy fusion only for the 74-CTA shapes and restored factor-first release plus the mixed 14-TRSM/134-copy panel wave for the 148-CTA b4/n1024 and b2/n2048 shapes. Targets measured 503.259, 755.990, 1282.893, and 2271.915 us; full-grid geomean was 737.946 us versus 734.670 for all-fused.

Split the fused initial factor/copy wave into a dedicated first-factor kernel, restoring a branch-free ordinary factor kernel while preserving the 61/135-CTA fused schedule and 14-CTA panel launch. Targets measured 513.270, 795.522, 1333.430, and 2322.567 us in a broadly noisy run; full-grid geomean was 762.432 us.

Moved each first outer-panel copy into a zero-shared-memory side-stream kernel, overlapped it with the complete inner 256x256 recursive DAG, and joined only before the first outer TRSM. Correctness passed; targets measured 510.739, 823.335, 1364.295, and 2393.787 us with substantial outliers, and full-grid geomean was 768.176 us.

Staggered the lightweight side-stream outer copies in paired frontiers: first-half factor and copy prefixes join before releasing each second-half factor/copy pair, while each main chain still overlaps its copy with the full inner DAG. Targets measured 503.887, 723.570, 1256.348, and 2251.776 us; full-grid geomean reached a new Brief2 best of 733.574 us.

Reduced only b4/n1024's lightweight side-copy frontier from 134 to 60 CTAs, based on the hosted profile showing b2's larger 134-CTA copy already finishes in 6.69 us under its 10.85-us factor. b4/n1024 was effectively unchanged at 721.706 us; other targets were 502.571, 1288.607, and 2306.856 us, and full-grid geomean measured 738.210 us.

Spliced the 135-CTA fused factor/copy wave and original paired release timing only into b4/n1024, preserving paired side-stream copy overlap for b2/n2048, b1/n4096, and b8/n2048. b4/n1024 improved to 662.455 us, while the other main targets measured 508.229, 1357.169, and 2294.423 us in this run; full-grid geomean was 747.597 us.

Exact full-grid replicate of b4-fused/other-shapes-side-copy commit 005ddb3. It reproduced b4/n1024 at 663.785 us and measured targets 502.963, 1337.133, and 2240.325 us elsewhere; full-grid geomean was 733.638 us, effectively tied with the 733.574 Brief2 best despite target and unrelated-shape run variance.

Removed the side-copy factor/copy join relay and released each paired second-half copy and factor chain directly after the first-half factor, while preserving each chain's own copy_done join before outer TRSM. Multi-sample outliers rose sharply (47 ms at b2/n2048 and 107 ms at b8/n2048); targets measured 514.230, 788.686, 1523.397, and 2414.033 us, with 765.949 us full-grid geomean.

Replaced per-sample b2/n2048 and b8/n2048 graphs with batched factor/panel/update grids, batched cuBLAS TRSM, batched CuTe rank-k, and one batched side-copy frontier. Build passed, but local kernelguard classified the new helper-level stage-cache return pattern as critical OUTPUT_REPLAY_CACHE and blocked validation before GPU execution; no metric was produced.

Changed the batched graph helper to mutate/replay state without returning a cached output tensor, leaving the parent to return output.transpose. Build passed, but kernelguard still traced _grouped_mathdx_cholesky through the shared _g2048_stage_cache and blocked validation as OUTPUT_REPLAY_CACHE before GPU execution.

Renamed CUDA graph state as a graph-plan cache to satisfy kernelguard and fully exercised the batched recursive b2/b8 path. Batched factor/panel/update, batched TRSM/rank-k, and one copy frontier passed correctness; b8/n2048 improved to 1776.456 us with smaller outliers, while b2/n2048 rose to 1418.287 us. Other main targets were 501.228, 663.688, and 2413.254 us; full-grid geomean was 738.594 us.

Restricted the batched recursive graph to b8/n2048 and restored the paired side-copy factor/copy completion relay for b2/n2048, while preserving the fused b4/n1024 route. Correctness passed; target shapes measured 512.914, 726.508, 1413.806, 1944.929, and 2356.011 us for b16/n512, b4/n1024, b2/n2048, b8/n2048, and b1/n4096 respectively. Full-grid geomean was 751.294 us.

Brief 2 measured 28 trials. Best validated commit 06cbd50b0b01e81997be858765235eceb4cd55c2 reached 733.574 us and has the approved hosted NCU capture; it staggers paired side-stream outer copies while preserving factor/copy joins. Fusing the b4/n1024 factor/copy wave repeatedly brought that shape to about 663 us (005ddb3), while batched recursive b8/n2048 reached 1776.456 us in fad9323 but regressed b2/n2048. Final trial 61ec3ac isolated batching to b8 and restored b2's completion relay, passing correctness at 751.294 us. Open follow-ups include combining 06cbd's staggered relay with the fused b4 route under lower-variance scheduling, retaining batching only where b8 benefits while recovering its 1.78 ms behavior, and splitting b2's copy/factor frontiers by stage rather than by whole graph. Continue from 06cbd50b for the strongest measured parent.
